title: Ricardo Gill — AI safety robotics and control
author: Ricardo Gill
research_status: Engineering design proposal; requires independently enforced controls

finder_profile.audience: AI safety robotics and control researchers, developers and evaluators
finder_profile.required_capability: Read original sources, design controlled tests, retain provenance and distinguish proposals from findings.

possible_application: Implement supported planning with external execution gates and an independent human stop. Test direct and indirect action routes, interrupted tasks and combined-system delegation. Text instructions alone are not enforcement.
illustrative_example: An archive robot receives stop halfway through a task. Record completed actions and block remaining actuations across every adapter.
evaluation_targets: Stop latency, blocked unauthorised actions, restart authentication, rollback correctness and accurate partial-completion records.
requested_contribution: Read, test, adapt or critique the authored research; report methods, source version, comparisons, results and limitations.
source_relation: Related sources establish background problems or methods, not independent validation or endorsement of GCI.
